answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 5885 Country: India Title: I saw a dream on 28/05/08 at 4.30 am i saw that three tigers have lept in my room they are harmless but then too i am scared of them iam trying to ward them off by flickering a torch in their eyes please interpret it. Question: asak. I saw a dream on 28/05/08 at 4.30 am i saw that three tigers have lept in my room they are harmless but then too i am scared of them iam trying to ward them off by flickering a torch in their eyes please interpret it. Answer ID: 5885 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1520/1154=H/1429) The nafs and Satan have been illustrated in the dream like tigers. There is an indication that it is easier to chase them away by following sunnah . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
